description: Generated by tools/prep/fixture/prepared.py. 'prepared': copies of fixture.prepared.epub that 'prep validate ../fixture.epub FILE' must reject; 'failing_checks' is the exact set of checks with status fail, 'codes' the exact set of failure codes. checker.reason: The reference answer of c0001-p1 (section s0001, d02-p001 to d02-p006) adds that the flash is made by a lens with four bright panels turning once every forty seconds. That is true in the book, but only section s0002 says it (d02-p008); s0001 describes the lens only as rings of cut glass that bend one flame into a beam (d02-p005). The draft cites d02-p005 and d02-p006 as if they supported it.

The prompt of c0002-p1 names the answer it asks for: it asks how the fisherman found his way 'by steering toward the sound of its fog horn', and the reference answer (supported by d03-p009) is that he steered by the sound of the fog horn alone.
